title: fix(organizations)!: retire claimOrphanOrgRows — it gives organization-less rows to the first organization, an owner by guess that ADR-0131 D9 and D10 forbid (measured 6342754850)
body:
Filing gate **③**: an unclassified item of #15212, found by the epic seat's reconciliation at `main` `2919ddb875`.
- **Who acts:** the epic seat dispatches the measurement.
- **Dedupe:** none ("claimOrphanOrgRows orphan rows first organization" → 0).

Part of #15212.

## What is on `main`
- `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-orphan-org-rows.ts:62`: `claimOrphanOrgRows` runs once, when the first organization is created. It back-fills `organization_id` on every `organization_id IS NULL` row of every user-defined object that declares the column.
- Its companion is `claim-org-seed-ownership.ts`. The caller is `organizations-plugin.ts:449-452`.
- It reads NULL rows and gives them an owner by guess. ADR-0131 D8 says NULL is not a state, and D10 says the ceremony never guesses an owner. It is on no stage list.

## Wanted (measurement only, no code)
- On which stores this release serves can it find a row? Check fresh `single` (the Default Organization exists at boot), walled, an 18.0.0-born store (nullable columns, voluntary ceremony), lean embedding, and `--dev`.
- Is any row it would claim one the ceremony also attributes? Could the two disagree?
- Recommend one of:
  - **A:** retire it;
  - **B:** keep it, with the ADR passage that allows it;
  - **C:** fold it into the ceremony.

  If B or C needs ADR text, the seat files a decision card for the maintainer.

## Acceptance
- An os-dev measurement report on this card, with commands and counts.
